title: Dilemmas in a general theory of planning
verified_evidence: Crossref query.bibliographic 'Rittel Webber Dilemmas in a general theory of planning 1973' returned DOI 10.1007/bf01405730, Policy Sciences vol 4 issue 2 pages 155-169, issued June 1973, authors Rittel and Webber. Also read the article pages 160-166 from the EPA-hosted scan.
kind: conceptual essay (planning theory), foundational paper on wicked problems

title: Wicked problems in design thinking
verified_evidence: Crossref query.bibliographic 'Buchanan Wicked problems in design thinking 1992' returned DOI 10.2307/1511637, Design Issues vol 8 issue 2, 1992. Pages 5-21 and publisher MIT Press confirmed on the JSTOR cover sheet of the PDF I read (pp. 5-16 viewed).

title: Of the Standard of Taste
verified_evidence: Web search for the essay returned full-text editions (users.rowan.edu Hume Archives text based on the 1875 Green and Grose edition, which states it appeared in 1757 in Four Dissertations) and the Stanford Encyclopedia entry 'Hume's Aesthetics' (plato.stanford.edu/archives/spr2020/entries/hume-aesthetics/). I fetched and read the Rowan full text and the Stanford entry. Crossref also lists a 2019 De Gruyter reprint chapter (10.1515/9783110585575-003) but that is not the original.

title: The Seven Lamps of Architecture
verified_evidence: Open Library search 'The Seven Lamps of Architecture Ruskin' returned work OL88638W. Title page of the Internet Archive scan sevenlampsarchi00conggoog (text layer read) reads 'London: Smith, Elder, and Co., 65 Cornhill. 1849' with contents listing the seven lamps.

title: The tall office building artistically considered
verified_evidence: Web search returned the Internet Archive scan tallofficebuildi00sull and a catalog line 'Lippincott's Monthly Magazine (1886-1915); Philadelphia (Mar 1896): 403'. I read the OCR text of the issue: running headers 403-408, contents list showing the essay at 403 and the following article at 409, copyright 1896 J. B. Lippincott Company, Philadelphia. Crossref returned only secondary works, not the original.

title: Ten principles for good design
verified_evidence: Fetched and read vitsoe.com/gb/about/good-design on 2026-11-27: lists the ten principles and says they were formulated in the late 1970s. Undated page, so year is the access year. Web search and the Jansen article (jansen.com/scale-en/themen/from-the-small-to-the-large-rules-for-good-design/) give dating 1975-1985. Open Library lists the related book Weniger, aber besser (OL9061379W, 1994, Jo Klatt).
